question: How many Golden Globe nominations will [TITLE] receive?

SHOW_TITLE.reason: The template refers to a television show's title. The available canonical vocabulary does not include SHOW_TITLE or SERIES_TITLE, so TITLE is the closest general content-title placeholder. FILM/MOVIE placeholders are too specific to movies.

resolution_date_rule: Resolution date should align with Golden Globe nomination announcement date.Resolution date should be December 1 of the calendar year.
